info.title: Laravel Central API
info.description:
## Authentication

1. Obtain a token via `POST /api/central/auth/login`.
2. Click **Authorize** above and enter the token (without the `Bearer` prefix).
3. Scramble sends it as `Authorization: Bearer {token}` on protected routes.

Public routes (login, signup, plans, webhooks) do not require a token.

UpdateApiKeyRequest.description: Validates incoming data for updating an existing tenant API key.
